openings.title: 观点类｜To what extent do you agree or disagree?
openings.use: 先明确立场，再概括最重要的判断依据。避免只写“This essay will discuss...”。

lines.en: While I acknowledge that [opposing point], I largely agree that [your position].
lines.cn: 虽然我承认……，但我总体赞同……。
lines.tip: 适合总体同意或部分同意。

lines.en: Although [the opposing view] has some merit, I believe that [your position] is more convincing.
lines.cn: 尽管相反观点有一定道理，我仍认为……更有说服力。

lines.en: I agree with this view to a considerable extent, primarily because [reason 1] and [reason 2].
lines.cn: 我在很大程度上赞同这一观点，主要因为……和……。

lines.en: In my view, the benefits of [issue] outweigh its potential drawbacks, provided that [condition].
lines.cn: 我认为……的益处大于潜在弊端，前提是……。
lines.tip: 适合“利大于弊且需条件”的立场。

openings.title: 双边讨论｜Discuss both views and give your opinion
openings.use: 分别交代两种观点，并在引言中给出自己的判断。

lines.en: People hold differing views on whether [view A] or [view B] should be prioritised. I believe that [your opinion].
lines.cn: 人们对于应优先考虑……还是……持有不同看法。我认为……。

lines.en: While some argue that [view A], others maintain that [view B]. In my opinion, [your position].
lines.cn: 有人认为……，另一些人则主张……。在我看来……。

lines.en: There are valid arguments on both sides; however, I would argue that [your position] because [main reason].
lines.cn: 双方都有合理之处，但我认为……，因为……。
lines.tip: 适合观点不绝对的题目。

openings.title: 利弊权衡｜Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
openings.use: 需要明确“哪一方更大”，而不是只说两面都有。

lines.en: Although [development] may create [main drawback], I believe its advantages are more substantial, particularly in terms of [area].
lines.cn: 尽管……可能带来……，我认为其优势更为显著，尤其体现在……。

lines.en: The growing prevalence of [development] has both benefits and costs, but on balance I consider it a positive development.
lines.cn: ……日益普及既有益处也有代价，但总体而言我认为这是积极的发展。

lines.en: Whether the benefits outweigh the costs depends largely on [condition]; when [condition is met], the overall impact is positive.
lines.cn: 利弊大小主要取决于……；当满足这一条件时，整体影响是积极的。
lines.tip: 适合有条件的权衡立场。

openings.title: 原因与解决｜Causes and solutions / Problems and measures
openings.use: 引言简要概括问题来源与应对方向，不必提前展开细节。

lines.en: The rise in [problem] can largely be attributed to [cause 1] and [cause 2]. Addressing it requires action from both [group A] and [group B].
lines.cn: ……问题的增加主要归因于……和……。解决这一问题需要……和……共同采取行动。

lines.en: Several factors have contributed to [problem], and a combination of targeted policies and individual action is needed to tackle it.
lines.cn: 多种因素导致了……，需要有针对性的政策与个人行动相结合来应对。

lines.en: This essay will examine the main drivers of [problem] and consider practical ways to reduce its impact.
lines.cn: 本文将分析……的主要成因，并探讨减少其影响的实际方法。

openings.title: 双问题｜Two-part questions
openings.use: 先概括第一问，再自然引出第二问；不要写成空泛模板。

lines.en: This trend is largely driven by [cause], while its wider implications include [effect].
lines.cn: 这一趋势主要由……推动，其更广泛的影响包括……。

lines.en: The main reasons for this preference are [reason 1] and [reason 2], and there are several ways to encourage [desired change].
lines.cn: 这种偏好的主要原因是……和……，同时可以通过多种方式鼓励……。
lines.tip: 适合 why + what can be done。

lines.en: This issue reflects changes in [background], and it raises important questions about [second question].
lines.cn: 这一问题反映了……的变化，也引出了关于……的重要问题。

openings.title: 积极/消极发展｜Positive or negative development
openings.use: 评价趋势的总体影响，并给出最核心的判断依据。

lines.en: Despite some possible disadvantages, I regard this as a largely positive development because [reason].
lines.cn: 尽管存在一些潜在缺点，我仍认为这总体是积极的发展，因为……。

lines.en: I consider this a negative trend, as its long-term costs for [group/area] are likely to outweigh any immediate benefits.
lines.cn: 我认为这是消极趋势，因为其对……的长期代价可能超过短期收益。

lines.en: The overall impact is mixed, but its consequences depend largely on how [issue] is managed.
lines.cn: 整体影响喜忧参半，但其后果主要取决于如何管理……。

body.title: 支持观点 / 优势中心句
body.use: 先点明收益，再限定收益对象或作用领域。

lines.en: [Development] can bring substantial benefits by [verb-ing] and [verb-ing].
lines.cn: ……可以通过……和……带来显著益处。

lines.en: One major advantage of [X] is that it enables [group] to [benefit].
lines.cn: ……的一项主要优势是使……能够……。

lines.en: The most significant contribution of [X] lies in its ability to [function].
lines.cn: ……最重要的贡献在于其能够……。

body.title: 反方观点 / 劣势中心句
body.use: 用 may/can 说明风险，不要绝对化。

lines.en: A major concern, however, is that [X] may [negative outcome].
lines.cn: 然而，一个主要担忧是……可能……。

lines.en: Despite these benefits, the growing use of [X] can create problems related to [area].
lines.cn: 尽管有这些好处，……的日益使用也可能带来与……有关的问题。

lines.en: One potential drawback is the risk of [noun phrase], particularly among [group].
lines.cn: 一个潜在缺点是……的风险，尤其是在……群体中。

body.title: 原因中心句
body.use: 明确指出原因，并为后续机制解释留空间。

lines.en: One major reason for [trend] is that [cause].
lines.cn: ……趋势的一个主要原因是……。

lines.en: This phenomenon can largely be attributed to [factor 1] and [factor 2].
lines.cn: 这一现象主要可归因于……和……。

lines.en: An underlying factor is the growing tendency for [group] to [behaviour].
lines.cn: 一个深层因素是……群体越来越倾向于……。

body.title: 解决措施中心句
body.use: 写清责任主体+行动方向。

lines.en: Addressing this issue requires coordinated efforts from governments and individuals.
lines.cn: 解决这一问题需要政府与个人协同努力。

lines.en: One practical measure would be for local authorities to [action].
lines.cn: 一个切实可行的措施是地方政府……。

lines.en: Schools and families can play complementary roles in helping children to [goal].
lines.cn: 学校与家庭可以发挥互补作用，帮助儿童……。

body.title: 让步与回应中心句
body.use: 先承认合理担忧，再说明并非不可解决。

lines.en: Admittedly, [X] may [drawback], but this risk can be reduced through [measure].
lines.cn: 诚然，……可能……，但可以通过……降低这一风险。

lines.en: Although this concern is legitimate, it does not necessarily mean that [extreme conclusion].
lines.cn: 尽管这一担忧合理，但这并不意味着……。

lines.en: The drawbacks should not be overlooked; nevertheless, they are manageable if [condition].
lines.cn: 缺点不应被忽视；然而，如果……，这些问题是可以管理的。

body.title: 比较与区分中心句
body.use: 适合对比两类人、两种政策或两个时期。

lines.en: Unlike [A], [B] is more likely to [difference].
lines.cn: 与……不同，……更可能……。

lines.en: The benefits are particularly clear for [group], whereas [other group] may face [challenge].
lines.cn: 这一益处对……尤其明显，而……群体可能面临……。

lines.en: Compared with [A], [B] offers a more [adjective] way to [goal].
lines.cn: 与……相比，……提供了一种更……的方式来……。

body.title: 重要性 / 必要性中心句
body.use: 避免空喊“important”，说明它为何重要。

lines.en: [X] plays a crucial role in [process/outcome], particularly when [condition].
lines.cn: ……在……中发挥关键作用，尤其是在……时。

lines.en: It is essential to [action] if society is to [long-term goal].
lines.cn: 如果社会要实现……，……至关重要。

lines.en: The value of [X] extends beyond [immediate benefit] to include [wider benefit].
lines.cn: ……的价值不仅体现在……，还包括……。

body.title: 个人责任中心句
body.use: 突出日常行为与累积影响。

lines.en: Individuals can make a meaningful contribution by [action] in their daily lives.
lines.cn: 个人可以通过日常……作出切实贡献。

lines.en: Consumers have a responsibility to [action], rather than relying entirely on [other party].
lines.cn: 消费者有责任……，而不是完全依赖……。

lines.en: Small changes in individual behaviour can collectively lead to [wider outcome].
lines.cn: 个人行为的小改变累积起来可以带来……。

body.title: 政府责任中心句
body.use: 写投资、监管、公共服务或公平性。

lines.en: Governments are well placed to address this issue through [policy/investment].
lines.cn: 政府适合通过……来解决这一问题。

lines.en: Public investment in [area] can improve access to [service] and reduce [inequality/problem].
lines.cn: 对……的公共投资可以改善……的可及性并减少……。

lines.en: Clear regulations are needed to ensure that [development] benefits society without causing [harm].
lines.cn: 需要明确的监管，以确保……造福社会而不造成……。

body.title: 综合评价 / 段落收束
body.use: 把前面机制落到结果，不要简单重复中心句。

lines.en: This, in turn, can [immediate result], ultimately contributing to [wider outcome].
lines.cn: 这反过来可以……，最终有助于……。

lines.en: Over time, these changes may lead to [long-term consequence].
lines.cn: 长期来看，这些变化可能导致……。

lines.en: Taken together, these factors explain why [overall judgement].
lines.cn: 综合来看，这些因素解释了为什么……。

logic.title: 补充同类论点
logic.use: 添加第二个相关原因/优势，避免连续使用 In addition。

lines.en: Another contributing factor is that ...
lines.cn: 另一个促成因素是……。

lines.en: Equally importantly, ...
lines.cn: 同样重要的是……。

lines.en: A further benefit is that ...
lines.cn: 另一个好处是……。

lines.en: Beyond this, ...
lines.cn: 除此之外……。

logic.title: 对比 / 区分
logic.use: 用于比较对象、群体、时期或趋势。

lines.en: By contrast, ...
lines.cn: 相比之下……。

lines.en: Whereas [A] ..., [B] ...
Unlike [A], [B] ...
Compared with [A], [B] ...

logic.title: 让步 / 限定
logic.use: 承认一部分合理性，再回到主张。

lines.en: Admittedly, ...
lines.cn: 诚然……。

lines.en: Although this may be true, ...
lines.cn: 尽管这可能属实……。

lines.en: This is not to say that ...
lines.cn: 这并不是说……。

lines.en: Even so, ...
lines.cn: 即便如此……。

logic.title: 原因 / 归因
logic.use: 解释现象背后的驱动因素。

lines.en: This can largely be attributed to ...
lines.cn: 这在很大程度上可归因于……。

lines.en: One underlying reason is that ...
lines.cn: 一个深层原因是……。

lines.en: This is partly because ...
lines.cn: 这在一定程度上是因为……。

lines.en: A key factor behind this trend is ...
lines.cn: 这一趋势背后的关键因素是……。

logic.title: 结果 / 递进后果
logic.use: 把机制推进到直接或长期结果。

lines.en: As a result, ...
lines.cn: 因此……。

lines.en: This, in turn, ...
lines.cn: 这反过来又……。

lines.en: Consequently, ...
lines.cn: 因此/结果是……。

lines.en: Over time, this may ...
lines.cn: 长期来看，这可能……。

logic.title: 举例 / 具体化
logic.use: 让论点落到具体情境，不要为了例子编造数据。

lines.en: For example, ...
lines.cn: 例如……。

lines.en: A case in point is ...
lines.cn: 一个典型例子是……。

lines.en: This is particularly evident in ...
lines.cn: 这一点在……中尤为明显。

lines.en: To illustrate, ...
lines.cn: 举例来说……。

logic.title: 解释 / 换言之
logic.use: 补充机制或把抽象观点说清楚。

lines.en: In practical terms, ...
lines.cn: 具体而言……。

lines.en: More specifically, ...
lines.cn: 更具体地说……。

lines.en: In other words, ...
lines.cn: 换句话说……。

lines.en: This means that ...
lines.cn: 这意味着……。

logic.title: 条件 / 前提
logic.use: 表达政策效果或立场成立的条件。

lines.en: Provided that ..., ...
lines.cn: 只要/前提是……，……。

lines.en: This is more likely to succeed when ...
lines.cn: 当……时，这更有可能成功。

lines.en: The benefits depend largely on whether ...
lines.cn: 益处在很大程度上取决于是否……。

lines.en: If properly managed, ...
lines.cn: 如果管理得当，……。

logic.title: 强调 / 重点转移
logic.use: 突出真正重要的判断标准。

lines.en: More importantly, ...
lines.cn: 更重要的是……。

lines.en: What matters most is whether ...
lines.cn: 最重要的是是否……。

lines.en: The key issue is not [A], but [B].
lines.cn: 关键问题不是……，而是……。

lines.en: Of particular importance is ...
lines.cn: 尤其重要的是……。

logic.title: 总结 / 权衡
logic.use: 用于段落或全文收束，避免机械堆叠。

lines.en: On balance, ...
lines.cn: 总体而言……。

lines.en: Taking these factors into account, ...
lines.cn: 考虑到这些因素……。

lines.en: Ultimately, the overall impact depends on ...
lines.cn: 归根结底，整体影响取决于……。

lines.en: For these reasons, ...
lines.cn: 基于这些原因……。

conclusions.title: 观点类结尾
conclusions.use: 重申立场并概括决定性理由。

lines.en: In conclusion, although [concession], I remain convinced that [position] because [key reason].
lines.cn: 总之，尽管……，我仍坚信……，因为……。

lines.en: Overall, the advantages of [X] outweigh its drawbacks, particularly when [condition].
lines.cn: 总体而言，……的优势超过缺点，尤其是在……时。

lines.en: For these reasons, I agree that [paraphrased position], provided that [safeguard].
lines.cn: 基于这些原因，我赞同……，前提是……。

conclusions.title: 双边讨论结尾
conclusions.use: 总结两方但明确自己的判断。

lines.en: In conclusion, while [view A] has its merits, I believe [view B] should be given greater priority because [reason].
lines.cn: 总之，尽管……有其合理性，我认为应更重视……，因为……。

lines.en: Both perspectives are understandable; nevertheless, [your view] offers a more convincing approach to [goal].
lines.cn: 两种观点都可以理解；然而，……对于实现……更有说服力。

conclusions.title: 利弊权衡结尾
conclusions.use: 直接回答 outweigh，不要只写两面都有。

lines.en: On balance, the benefits of [development] are greater than its costs, as long as [condition].
lines.cn: 总体而言，只要……，……的益处就大于代价。

lines.en: Although [drawback] remains a concern, it is manageable and does not outweigh the wider benefits of [X].
lines.cn: 尽管……仍值得担忧，但它可以得到控制，不足以抵消……的广泛益处。

conclusions.title: 原因与措施结尾
conclusions.use: 简要回扣原因，突出措施方向。

lines.en: In conclusion, [problem] stems mainly from [cause]. A combination of [measure A] and [measure B] is therefore needed to address it.
lines.cn: 总之，……主要源于……。因此需要结合……和……来解决。

lines.en: These measures would help tackle the immediate causes while reducing the likelihood of the problem recurring.
lines.cn: 这些措施既能解决直接原因，也能降低问题再次发生的可能性。

conclusions.title: 积极 / 消极发展结尾

lines.en: Overall, I regard this as a positive development because its long-term benefits for [area] are likely to be substantial.
lines.cn: 总体而言，我认为这是积极的发展，因为其对……的长期益处可能十分显著。

lines.en: Unless effective steps are taken, the negative consequences of this trend are likely to become more serious.
lines.cn: 如果不采取有效措施，这一趋势的负面后果可能会更加严重。

conclusions.title: 双问题结尾
conclusions.use: 同时回应两问，避免引入新论点。

lines.en: In short, [answer to question 1], and [answer to question 2] would be the most practical way forward.
lines.cn: 简言之，……；而……将是最切实可行的解决方向。

lines.en: These factors explain why [phenomenon occurs], while [measure/condition] could help improve the situation.
lines.cn: 这些因素解释了……为何发生，而……可以帮助改善现状。

task1.title: Overview｜总览句
task1.use: 概括主要趋势、最高最低、排名变化或阶段特征，不罗列所有数字。

lines.en: Overall, the most noticeable feature is that ...
lines.cn: 总体而言，最显著的特征是……。

lines.en: Overall, [A] showed an upward trend, whereas [B] declined over the period.
lines.cn: 总体而言，A 呈上升趋势，而 B 在此期间下降。

lines.en: It is clear that [A] remained the largest category, while [B] accounted for the smallest share.
lines.cn: 显然，A 始终是最大类别，而 B 所占比例最小。

lines.en: Overall, the process consists of [number] main stages, beginning with ... and ending with ...
lines.cn: 总体而言，该流程包含……个主要阶段，从……开始，以……结束。

task1.title: 数据趋势｜上升下降与波动
task1.use: 选择与幅度匹配的动词和副词，避免所有变化都写 increase/decrease。

lines.en: The figure rose steadily from [x] to [y].
lines.cn: 数值从 x 稳步上升至 y。

lines.en: There was a sharp increase in [category], reaching [figure].
lines.cn: 某类别大幅增长，达到……。

lines.en: [Category] experienced a gradual decline over the period.
lines.cn: 某类别在此期间逐渐下降。

lines.en: The figure fluctuated before stabilising at [x].
lines.cn: 数值波动后稳定在……。

task1.title: 比较与占比｜分组描述
task1.use: 用比较关系组织细节段，不要逐项机械报数。

lines.en: [A] accounted for the largest share, at [x]%.
lines.cn: A 所占比例最大，为 x%。

lines.en: [A] was approximately twice as high as [B].
lines.cn: A 约为 B 的两倍。

lines.en: The figures for [A] and [B] were [x] and [y], respectively.
lines.cn: A 和 B 的数值分别为 x 和 y。

lines.en: By comparison, [A] made up a much smaller proportion of the total.
lines.cn: 相比之下，A 所占总量比例小得多。

task1.title: 地图 / 流程｜空间变化与步骤
task1.use: 地图用位置和变化动词；流程用被动语态和顺序表达。

lines.en: The area underwent substantial redevelopment, with [feature] being replaced by [new feature].
lines.cn: 该区域经历了大规模改造，某设施被新设施取代。

lines.en: [Feature] was converted into [new use].
lines.cn: 某设施被改建为……。

lines.en: Once this stage is complete, the material is transferred to ...
lines.cn: 这一步完成后，材料被转移至……。

lines.en: The process begins with [stage] and is followed by [next stage].
lines.cn: 该流程从……开始，随后进入……阶段。

positive.cn: 扩大优质教育的可及性
positive.example: Online courses can broaden access to quality education for students in remote areas.
Open-ended classroom discussions can foster critical thinking.
Vocational programmes equip students with practical skills for the workplace.
Affordable higher education can promote social mobility.
Public funding can provide equal learning opportunities for disadvantaged children.

positive.phrase: cultivate a lifelong love of learning
positive.example: Supportive teachers can cultivate a lifelong love of learning.

negative.example: Unequal access to digital devices can widen educational inequalities.
High-stakes examinations may place excessive pressure on students.
An exam-focused system can encourage rote learning.
Tuition fees can impose a heavy financial burden on low-income families.
A lack of learning support may leave disadvantaged pupils behind.

negative.cn: 削弱学生的内在学习动力
negative.example: Constant comparison can undermine students’ intrinsic motivation.

positive.example: AI can streamline repetitive tasks and free employees to focus on complex work.
Automation can enhance productivity across many industries.
Digital platforms improve access to information.
Video-conferencing tools facilitate remote collaboration.
AI-assisted imaging can support early disease detection.
Adaptive software can personalise learning experiences.

negative.cn: 取代常规职业中的劳动者
negative.example: AI-driven automation may displace workers in routine occupations.
Unequal internet access can deepen the digital divide.
Overreliance on AI may undermine independent thinking.
Unverified posts can spread misleading information rapidly.
Poorly protected platforms may compromise personal data.
Short-form content can encourage excessive screen time.

positive.example: Investment in renewable energy can reduce carbon emissions.
Well-managed nature reserves help protect biodiversity.
Recycling programmes can conserve natural resources.
Restrictions on private cars can improve urban air quality.
Clear product labels can promote sustainable consumption.
Reforestation projects can restore degraded ecosystems.

negative.example: Excessive consumption can deplete non-renewable resources.
Uncontrolled development can destroy natural habitats.
Heavy reliance on fossil fuels can accelerate climate change.
Poorly planned tourism can cause long-term ecological damage.

negative.cn: 使野生动物承受生存压力
negative.example: Habitat loss places wildlife under increasing pressure.

negative.phrase: shift environmental costs onto future generations
negative.cn: 将环境代价转嫁给后代
negative.example: Unsustainable policies shift environmental costs onto future generations.

positive.example: International tourism can foster intercultural understanding.
Cultural tourism generates income for local communities.
Tourism revenue can support heritage preservation.
Tourism can create employment opportunities in rural areas.
Travel provides first-hand cultural experiences that books cannot fully replicate.

positive.phrase: strengthen a sense of cultural identity
positive.example: Community festivals can strengthen a sense of cultural identity.

negative.example: Mass tourism can commercialise cultural traditions.
Staged performances may erode cultural authenticity.

negative.cn: 给当地基础设施带来压力
negative.example: Peak-season tourism puts pressure on local infrastructure.
Large visitor numbers can damage historic sites.
